title: Log and error reporting
subtitle: The log stays on your computer: StarLight never sends anything automatically.
intro: StarLight records startup, shutdown and errors here. To report a problem, use “Copy report” and paste the text into your message: it contains the version, the system and the last lines of the log, with your personal folder shown as %USERPROFILE% and without your user name. It contains no images.
afterRestart: The log will be available after StarLight restarts.
noProblems: No errors or warnings in the log.
openFolderHint: Opens the folder with the log files in File Explorer
copyReportHint: Copies to the clipboard the text to paste into a bug report

notices.copied: Report copied. Paste it into your report message (Ctrl+V).
notices.copyFailed: Could not copy the report. You can open the log folder and attach the file.
notices.clearFailed: Could not clear the log: a file may be open in another program.

severe.title: An error occurred last time
severe.text: {description}. If you want to report it, you’ll find the report to copy in the log.
severe.textWithWhen: {description}, {when}. If you want to report it, you’ll find the report to copy in the log.
